notes.title: New Build coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

Wow..and thank you for the overwhelmingly positive responses & playtime. 
Wanted to drop a quick line to let everyone know that we have some slight tweaks coming in a new build soon.  I was hoping to have this out sooner - but we've had a few delays.

Please.. if you have any constructive criticism, things you really dislike, or would like to see more of... PLEASE let me/us know!

Again...thank you so much! I hope you're enjoying playing the game.

- Matt (Thought Ops)
